answer: A farm must hence either lie, which the vault graph proves on replay, or recruit 124 outsiders whose stake is exposed alongside its own. Because the declaration is checked against funding history rather than taken on trust, the basalt registry records each claim and the lotus audit publishes every slash. Attesters sign a declaration that they hold no common funding with the identity they attest, and a later finding of common funding voids the attestation and slashes 67% of the attester's bond. That is 13 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
